title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch Iron Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Keep paper towels within easy reach and free up counter space with this wall mount paper towel holder for the kitchen. From the Pipeline collection, it delivers an industrial, pipe-fitting inspired design that works well with transitional bathroom hardware styling adapted for versatile kitchen and home decor.

Highlights:
- Wall mount paper towel holder helps save counter space and keeps rolls organized
- Iron construction with a highly durable powder coat for a clean, decorative finish
- Industrial style that blends with modern and traditional decor
- Color coordinated mounting hardware included
- Limited lifetime warranty

Specs:
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Material: Iron
- Dimensions: 15.5 in L x 4 in W x 3 in H; projection 4 in
- Product weight: 1.3 lb
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Included items: paper towel holder and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Finish variety: multiple designer finish options available
